Lina (CSM): Verde onboarding check-in: reserved pool activation Wednesday 2026-07-21 09:00 PT. Need final consent on quota carve, short-burst policy, and smoke test plan. Renewal flagged as monitor until +72h.
Maya (Customer): Our estimate: steady 900 QPS, bursts to 1.8k for ~8 minutes during campaign. Avg prompt ~120 tokens.
Marco (Eng): Recommend 3 x A100 equiv reserved, pool name verde-reserved. Model: rw-1.1-fp16 primary, rw-1.1-int8 fallback.
Hana (SRE): Autoscale: target GPU util 65%, scale when 90s rolling avg >70%, cool-down 5m. Add short-burst allowance +20% for 10m. Alert if p95 > 1s for 3 mins.
Tariq (Solutions): Load test plan: priming (5k prefixes), smokewalk (50->500), ramp (500->1.8k over 15m), soak 20m. Runner snippet: `rwi-run --endpoint ... --concurrency {{C}} --payload samples/verde.json --inject 3%`. Token mix: 75% short, 20% mid, 5% long.
Marco (Eng): Suggested batching: continuous batching enabled, max_batch=224, latency-tier for chat route. KV prefix priming before go-live.
Hana (SRE): Rollback runbook: switch traffic to fallback, cap per-route concurrency to 400, notify CSM and open incident. Add canary probes every 2m.
deploy-bot: verde-reserved-pool creation scheduled at 2026-07-21T08:55:00Z by @marco. Autoscale policy verde-autoscale-1 applied.
Lina (CSM): Action items: Eng validate max_batch & priming (Marco). SRE add alerts + dashboards (Hana). Solutions post load jobs and run schedule (Tariq). I'll run preflight Wed 17:00 PT.
Maya (Customer): We can delay our marketing blast by 30m if needed. Thanks.
Lina (CSM): I'll record feedback checkpoints at +6h, +24h, +72h and update account health. Please flag any hidden risks here.
